title: Wisconsin Maritime Museum

services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: The Wisconsin Maritime Museum’s Education Department offers a wide variety of formal and informal educational programs for youth, homeschool, scout and school groups. This hands-on, interactive tour takes groups through Wisconsin’s history using shipwrecks. This program can be modified to be suitable for all ages. This hands-on program will ask students to move invasive species around the Great Lakes and see for themselves how these aquatic invaders have changed our watershed forever. Learn about how remotely operated vehicles are used today in underwater research. Groups will build and test their own robot in water! Sponsored by Festival Foods & Burger

services.name: Weddings & Event Rentals
services.desc: We offer a variety of spaces to rent for private and public events, corporate meetings, celebrations, weddings, and presentations. Our skilled and enthusiastic crew want to make your next event of any kind a success! The Roof Deck offers 3,100 square feet of outdoor space with a panoramic view of the Manitowoc River and downtown Manitowoc. The Deck is ideal for ceremonies, parties, reunions, and receptions. With 1,800 square feet that can be divided into up to three separate rooms, the Riverview Room can accommodate groups of many sizes and arrangements.
